title: Thai-Style Chili Stir-Fry with Melted Cheese
description: A spicy and savory Thai-inspired stir-fry with the addition of melted cheese. Perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of chilisteraksaus in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the snow peas and cook until tender, about 2-3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and fish sauce.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the vegetables and stir to combine.
Add the shredded nmolten and stir until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with chopped cilantro or scallions, if desired.
